name: Action Over Deliberation
description:
When the party debates how to handle a dangerous situation, your patience wears thin. For each suggested course of action beyond the first—by anyone but you—roll 1d6 and add it to a running total. If the total exceeds 10, choose one:

  • Charge ahead recklessly, ignoring companions’ concerns.

  • Break something, make a loud noise, or reveal sensitive information.

  • Check two conditions.

If the party agrees on a plan before you cross the threshold, halve your total (round down) and gain that many +1d to use while executing the plan.

Describe how your temper simmers or boils over.
